definition: The declared systematic sources of the per-class balancing-yield envelope, each mapped to the variation campaigns that measure it. This file declares WHICH sources and WHICH arms enter the envelope. It holds no measured value. It decides no physics question: a source or an arm stays included until an owner ruling excludes it, and an included arm without a PASS measurement receipt stops the envelope.
authority: docs/SYSTEMATICS_PREREGISTRATION.md sections 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and the 2026-08-18 owner amendment. Ruling R7 makes this module detachable. Rulings R9 and R11 of 2026-08-23 exclude one arm and one source. The internal DECISIONS.md carries R7, R9, R10 and R11.
campaign_map_owner: config/systematics_variations_v1.json declares the PYTHIA setting each campaign changes. This file declares which source each campaign serves, and whether the arm is included. extraction/combine_per_class.py::SOURCES holds the included map for the arithmetic and must agree with this file. tools/systematics_envelope.py refuses when the two disagree.
arm_rule: Pre-registration 2.5: a two-sided source quotes the arm with the larger |Delta| per class. Not half the spread, and not an envelope. A source whose second arm is excluded is quoted ONE-SIDED as measured, and is never symmetrised.
campaign_entry: Each entry of a source's `campaigns` list is an object: `campaign` names the variation campaign, `included` says whether the arm enters the envelope, and `reason` states why the arm is declared. An excluded arm also carries `exclusion_reason`, which names the ruling. Excluded arms are KEPT in this file: a source that was measured and then ruled out is a different object from a source nobody examined, and only the record tells them apart.
exclusion_rule: Every entry with `included: false`, source or arm, must carry a non-empty `exclusion_reason`. tools/systematics_envelope.py refuses an exclusion with no reason, and copies every exclusion with its reason into the envelope's `exclusions` block.

campaigns.reason: Registered in pre-registration section 5 and launched. The MONASH p80 and p90 quantiles both resolve to N_ch = 2, so the 80-90 per cent class needs the empty integer range [3,2]. The pipeline wrote a FAIL receipt with 0/132 rows and returned nonzero, which was the correct refusal. Ten million events were present: the failure is an atom in the discrete event-activity distribution, not a statistics shortage. The owner ruled R9 on 2026-08-23. The arm stays declared here, excluded, because the measurement happened and the record must show it.

sources.reason: Two-sided as registered, ONE-SIDED as measured under R9. HF_SYS_PTHAT_4 is the only arm in the envelope, and its shift is quoted as measured, never symmetrised. Any scientifically valid integrated observable from the HF_SYS_PTHAT_1 campaign may still be used elsewhere; R9 excludes the arm from this per-class envelope only.

sources.reason: Registered in pre-registration section 7 and measured as an exact structural zero on 2026-08-17. That measurement was taken on the retired common absolute axis and its artifacts are untracked, so it does not carry to the v2 percentile axis. The owner ruled R11 on 2026-08-23: S5 enters no budget and produces no number until it is re-derived on the percentile axis. The entry stays here so that the pending re-derivation has a declared home.
